description:
Wire C2's resolver into the live query path. BRD §7.2.

Files:
  - src/app/api/query/route.ts — replace MODELS[user.tier] with
    slug-aware logic: load user_preferences.preferred_model,
    default to 'deepseek' if null or tier=free, resolve via
    resolveCuratedModel(), pass into complete()/completeStream().
  - src/lib/prefs.ts — extend loadPrefs to include preferred_model
    in SELECT and returned shape (nullable slug type).
  - src/lib/types.ts — extend UserPreferences type with new field.
  - src/__tests__/api.test.ts (extend) — pro+anthropic resolves to
    sonnet-4.6; pro+null resolves to deepseek-v4-pro; free with
    any preference still resolves to default (free can't pick).

Done when:
  - Pro user with no pref saved → DeepSeek V4 Pro on every query.
  - Pro user with preferred_model='anthropic' → Sonnet 4.6, with
    resolved ID stored in queries.model_used.
  - Free user → DeepSeek V4 Pro regardless of preferred_model
    value.
  - Cost estimate before reserveBudget uses resolved ID's pricing
    (verified by checking queries.cost_usd).
  - npx tsc --noEmit clean; full suite pass.

Tests:
  - Unit: route handler with mocked auth/loadPrefs/complete/
    reserveBudget/finalizeBudget — assert complete() called with
    resolved ID.
  - Smoke (manual, post-deploy): query as pro user, flip
    preference via SQL on VPS, query again, verify
    queries.model_used shows the new ID.

Operator action post-merge: none. Default switch (Sonnet 4.5 →
DeepSeek V4 Pro) happens silently on next pro user query. C7's
banner is the user-facing announcement.

Depends on: C1 (preferred_model column), C2 (CURATED_MODELS map).

resolution.note: Slug resolution wired into /api/query: pro reads preferred_model, free pinned to DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG, stale/unknown slugs fall through to default. complete/completeStream signature changed to take resolved modelId. UserPreferences type gained preferredModel: string | null (required); all fixtures updated. /api/preferences PUT validates against isCuratedSlug. 209 tests pass.
